y_hook1.text: [serious] Fourteen thousand premature deaths a year in Kazakhstan are linked to air pollution.

y_hook2.text: [quietly] Up to twenty-one hundred of them... in Almaty alone.

y_intro.text: The answers that could protect people are buried in a hundred and fifty sources from A-A-I. Taza Copilot finds them in seconds. Meet three people.

y_dana1.text: On November second, a Tengrinews journalist sent A-A-I six questions. Answering them took the team about five hours: six pages, twenty-three sources.

y_dana2.text: So we asked Taza the same six questions. Live, on the platform.

y_aliya1.text: Aliya has two kids. She doesn't open websites. She texts Taza on WhatsApp, like a friend. In Russian, English, or Kazakh.

y_aliya2.text: And when her hands are full... she just calls.

y_tg1.text: On Telegram: a daily air card for the school, questions by voice, and rumours fact-checked.

y_tg2.text: Air near me, saved places, alerts, and inline in any chat.

y_arman1.text: Nine p.m. Arman is driving the evening rush for inDrive. Taza tells him the air right now, the worst hours, and the cleanest.

y_arman2.text: Stuck in traffic? Shut the windows. With them open, drivers breathe air seven times dirtier than pedestrians. [pause] A-A-I's research, page five.

y_arman3.text: One call to Taza's partner API. For every driver and rider, in three languages.

y_admin1.text: Behind it all: the A-A-I team. One person, no code. Upload a report, and Taza quotes it seconds later, with a five-point summary for subscribers.

y_admin2.text: It checks air.org.kz every day, hides an outdated source in one click, and shows what nobody could answer yet.

y_proof.text: Every answer is measured: forty-four out of forty-four correct. Any AI provider works, or a local model, where the AI cost is zero. Hosting: about seven dollars a month.

y_metric.text: [serious] From hours of reading reports... to a sourced answer in seconds.

y_thanks.text: Thank you. Try it, right now. [pause] And now... over to Aimira.

c4_en_q.text: Hi Taza! Can my kids walk to school this morning?

c4_en_a.text: Yes, the morning is one of the cleanest times today. Avoid eight to ten in the evening.

c4_ru_q.text: А какая школа в Алматы с самым грязным воздухом?

c4_ru_a.text: По исследованию AAI — школа номер сто пятьдесят шесть, в Алатауском районе.

c4_kk_q.text: Ал 2025 жылы қай ауданда ауа ең лас болды?

c4_kk_a.text: Түрксіб ауданы: орташа PM2.5 қырық алты бүтін сегіз микрограмм, Бостандықтан екі еседен астам жоғары.
